blocks.text: Atomic radius atom ke size ka paimana (measure) hai. Yeh aapas mein jure (bonded) do ek jaise atoms ke darmiyan fasle ka aadha hota hai. Atomic radius bond ki qism (covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces) ya atom ki halat (state) ke mutabiq badal sakta hai. Maslan covalent bond mein radius ionic bond se mukhtalif ho sakta hai. Atomic radius aam taur par picometers (pm) ya Angstroms (Å) mein napa jata hai.

blocks.alt: Atoms golon ki shakal mein, apne radius ke mutabiq chhote bare: purane groups 1 se 8 baen se daen aur periods 1 se 6 oopar se neeche: H aur He; Li se Ne; Na se Ar; K, Ca aur Ga se Kr; Rb, Sr aur In se Xe; Cs, Ba aur Tl se Rn. Oopar ka teer 'atomic size decreases' (baen se daen) aur baen ka teer 'atomic size increases' (neeche ki taraf).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har gola (sphere) ek atom hai aur us ka size atomic radius dikhata hai. Ek row (period) mein baen se daen gole chhote hote jate hain, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta hai aur electrons qareeb khinch jate hain. Ek column (group) mein neeche gole bare hote jate hain, kyun ke har qadam par naya shell jurta hai. Kitab ki figure mein kuch symbols ghalat chhape hain: H ki jagah '11', Cl ki jagah 'Ci', Ge ki jagah 'Gc', Se ki jagah 'Sc', In ki jagah 'ln', Te ki jagah 'Tc', Xe ki jagah 'Xc' aur Po ki jagah 'Pa'. Yahan sahi symbols likhe gaye hain.

Atomic radius par asar dalne wale factors yeh hain: atomic number, effective nuclear charge (nucleus ki asal kashish jo bahar ke electron mehsoos karte hain) aur andar wale electrons ka shielding effect. Aam taur par period mein baen se daen atomic radius kam hota hai, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta hai aur electron cloud ko qareeb kheench leta hai. Is ke ulat group mein oopar se neeche atomic radius barhta hai, kyun ke naye electron shells jurte hain; zyada shielding atom ko bara kar deti hai, halan ke nuclear charge bhi barhta hai, magar shells ka asar zyada hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium ka atom magnesium se bara kyun hai, lekin potassium se chhota kyun?
blocks.explanation: Magnesium usi period mein sodium ke baad hai: ek extra proton usi bahar wale shell ko qareeb kheenchta hai, is liye magnesium chhota hai. Potassium usi group mein sodium ke neeche hai: us ka ek extra shell hai aur andar ke electrons ki shielding barhe hue nuclear charge par bhari hai, is liye potassium bara hai.

items: Atomic radius: do jure hue ek jaise atoms ke fasle ka aadha, pm ya Å mein; bond ki qism aur atom ki halat par depend.
Period mein baen se daen kam (zyada nuclear charge, wohi shell); group mein neeche zyada (zyada shells, zyada shielding).
